purpose: Hand-seeded calibration set for separating learner difficulty, admission suitability, and presentation mode before changing en-ja SRS admission behavior.

difficulty_bands.intermediate: Expected learner difficulty from 0.55 through below 0.80.
difficulty_bands.advanced: Expected learner difficulty at or above 0.80.

difficulty_target_scale: expected_learner_difficulty is a reviewed continuous 0.00-1.00 learner-difficulty target, not a percent-through-language value and not a default-priority score. Values near 0 are first-session vocabulary; lower priority or topic-specific but easy words should stay low difficulty and be handled by separate priority/topic signals.
